summary: Verified Magazzino 'Cerca Pedana' bugfix at 390x844. All 6 feature flows pass. (1) Chip visibility: 7 chips (3 date + 4 status) all rendered at exactly height=36px with widths >=85px; date row y=238 and status row y=289.5 — two distinct rows, both fully below the search card (bottom y=218), no clipping or overlap. (2) Grouping/sort: seeded 3 TEST orders via office API with numeroOrdine TEST_100/TEST_200/TEST_300; groups appeared in ascending order (y100=4969 < y200=5133 < y300=5297 before filter; y100=377 < y200=541 < y300=705 under search), and inside TEST_300 the two pedane rendered as T3A then T3B (numeric codice sort). (3) Group header: magazzino-group-numero-* shows 'Ord. <N>', magazzino-group-summary-* shows '<date> · N posizioni · N pedane · N colli', magazzino-group-progress-* shows '0/2' with no 'ordine-completo' badge for incomplete orders. (4) Row click opens pedana-detail-card and magazzino-back-to-results-button returns to grouped list. (5) Without operator name: no magazzino-scarica-ordine-button-* rendered anywhere and the readonly hint is visible; after setting the name via magazzino-operatore-button → magazzino-nome-input → magazzino-nome-save-button, the scarica button appeared for incomplete TEST_300 and the confirm sheet (confirm+cancel) opened correctly (cancelled safely; no real data mutated). (6) Date filter 'Oggi' excludes the TEST_200 tomorrow order; status filter 'Scaricate' hides all in-attesa orders; filter counts (date-filter-count-*/filter-count-*) match API. (7) Search 'TEST_' preserves grouping, filters correctly, and keeps ascending sort. (8) No horizontal overflow: scrollWidth=clientWidth=390. No React Native red screen, no console errors. All seeded TEST pedane deleted via DELETE /api/pedane/{id}; verified 0 TEST_* remain. No real DB rows modified.
critical_code_review_comments: magazzino.tsx L167-213: Two chip ScrollViews wrapped in fixed `styles.chipWrap` { height: 52, flexShrink: 0 }, with chip height=36 inside — correctly prevents the previous collapse-to-10px bug. Verified at runtime: all 7 chips render at exactly 36px tall in two separate rows.

magazzino.tsx L117-119: `const selected = q.trim() && results.length === 1 ? results[0] : …` auto-opens the detail card when a search returns exactly one result. This is pre-existing behavior but note that when searching for a single-match ordine (e.g. 'TEST_100_075516'), the group list is bypassed. Not a bug, but worth documenting as expected UX.

magazzino.tsx L410-420: groupByOrder() sorts groups via localeCompare('it', { numeric: true }) and rows by codice numeric compare — matches requirement 'ordine di numero ordine ascending'. Verified empirically (TEST_100 → TEST_200 → TEST_300).
magazzino.tsx L320-329: Scarica button is wrapped in `!!operatore && !complete` — correctly hidden when no operator name is set, and hidden for completed orders. Verified both states at runtime.

magazzino.tsx L282-296: magazzino-ordine-completo-{numero} testID is attached to the countPill only when complete=true (`testID={complete ? 'magazzino-ordine-completo-…' : undefined}`) — avoids false positives on incomplete orders.
magazzino.tsx L2: expo-haptics import — fine on web preview (no-op). No deprecated expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch usage detected.

magazzino.tsx L425 `chipWrap: { height: 52, flexShrink: 0 }` — chose fixed height instead of minHeight to guarantee the row doesn't collapse under flex pressure from parent. Good defensive styling for this bug class.

rca_of_issue: N/A — bug previously fixed by main agent is confirmed resolved. The chip row originally collapsed to ~10px because the outer wrapper lacked a fixed height and shrank under flex pressure from the parent column; the fix (styles.chipWrap { height: 52, flexShrink: 0 }) with two separate ScrollViews now guarantees both filter rows render at full height (36px chips in a 52px container) stacked under the search box with no overlap.
